title: Bulk Action For Forms
content:
## Bulk Action For Forms


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078793

A set of bulk actions is available for custom or brand-new forms under Toolbox >> Form Manager . These actions are not available for default forms.

The available bulk actions are Delete , Enable , and Disable :

NOTE: Bulk Delete permanently removes the selected forms and cannot be undone. If the goal is to deactivate forms while keeping them available for future use, use Disable instead.

To perform a bulk action on forms:

1. Select all forms using the select-all checkbox shown below:

Or select the forms individually:

Then select one of the bulk actions available and click on Apply :

Once clicked, a confirmation pop-up will appear:

Once confirmed, selected bulk action will apply to the selected forms:
